what_is_supported: Interpretability conclusions describe the locked model on the development-validation distribution.
what_is_not_supported: A claim that these explanation patterns have been independently confirmed on a fresh untouched final test set.
practical_implication: Treat Notebook 08 as model-behavior analysis, not as a new independent generalization study.

what_is_supported: The model explains predictive relationships learned from the historical UCI diabetes hospital dataset.
what_is_not_supported: Direct assumptions that the same relationships or effect magnitudes apply to present-day clinical practice.
practical_implication: Contemporary deployment would require newer data and external validation.

what_is_supported: Patient-aware validation limits same-patient overlap across evaluation folds.
what_is_not_supported: Evidence that the model transports consistently across specific hospitals, health systems, or geographic settings.

what_is_supported: Permutation analysis identifies features or groups whose disruption changes model performance.
what_is_not_supported: Clean additive attribution of predictive contribution when features encode overlapping information.
practical_implication: Grouped permutation and representation-aware interpretation should be preferred over summing individual importances.

what_is_supported: PDP and categorical profiles describe how the fitted model responds when selected inputs are varied.
what_is_not_supported: Evidence that those changes represent feasible or causal clinical interventions.
practical_implication: Interpret curves as properties of the prediction function, not treatment-response curves.

what_is_supported: The model produces different average predictions across specific perturbed categorical values.
what_is_not_supported: Observed outcome-rate differences, causal subgroup effects, or evidence of biological mechanisms.
practical_implication: Category profiles require support checks and contextual interpretation.

what_is_supported: Global and semi-global interpretation through permutation, grouped importance, PDP, and categorical profiles.
what_is_not_supported: Patient-specific additive attribution from a local SHAP framework.
practical_implication: Notebook 08 focuses on global model behavior rather than individual encounter explanations.

what_is_supported: Predictive associations learned by the locked model.
what_is_not_supported: Causal effects, intervention effects, treatment effects, or mechanism claims.
practical_implication: No clinical intervention recommendation should be derived from these explanation results alone.

what_is_supported: Patient-aware grouped validation across the available development dataset.
what_is_not_supported: Evidence of model stability across historical time periods or future temporal drift.

what_is_supported: Diagnosis-family features are used by the locked model and carry measurable predictive dependence.
what_is_not_supported: A claim that diagnosis-family encoding performs better than raw ICD-9 diagnosis codes.
practical_implication: Diagnosis-family engineering can be interpreted within the locked pipeline but not ranked against an unbuilt raw-code model.

limitation: No production drift or recalibration analysis
what_is_supported: Interpretation of the current locked development model.
what_is_not_supported: Evidence that feature behavior, calibration, prevalence, or performance would remain stable after deployment.
practical_implication: A production system would require drift monitoring, recalibration checks, and periodic revalidation.
